entries.note: He expresses lack of confidence rather than firmly asserting that the remaining business is small.

entries.test: Public customer revenue breakdowns, cloud growth contributions, and investor disclosures would establish the asserted concentration and whether it was disclosed.
entries.note: The accusation has a concrete factual basis that can be tested without establishing private intent.
The historical superlative expresses a judgment of investment worth without a defined ranking criterion.
The proposition preserves both 'likely' and the condition on the labs' continued existence and ability to pay.

entries.test: Public breakdowns of hyperscaler AI revenues by customer would establish how much revenue remains after excluding the two labs' compute spending.
entries.note: The dependency assertion is factual despite the accompanying judgment that remaining revenues are 'pathetic.'

entries.test: Wells Fargo's published FY2026 Copilot estimate, Microsoft's paid-seat disclosures, and realized subscription prices would test the stated revenue, seat count, and discount inference.
entries.note: The numerical assertions are checkable; 'meaningful' and 'questionable value' remain evaluative.

entries.test: If either lab ceases operating, public industry compute spending and production figures before and after its closure would show whether at least half disappears.
entries.note: He asserts the consequence within a scenario, without asserting that this scenario must occur.
The central commitment is an urgent recommendation for regulation.

entries.test: If hyperscalers stop expanding data centers and funding the two labs, subsequent public cloud and associated-service growth figures would show whether growth slows.
entries.note: The normalization reasonably preserves the stated antecedent.

entries.test: Public financial results excluding the two labs' contributions would show whether underlying growth and profitability are deteriorating and how AI returns compare with investment.
entries.note: The business deterioration assertion is testable; 'catastrophic failure' adds an evaluative characterization.
The combined claim explicitly qualifies the amount and says it is 'almost certainly' an overestimate.
This is a counterfactual assessment of current commitments at a hypothetical revenue scale, rather than a forecast of reaching that scale.

entries.test: Public financial statements and operating plans would show whether either lab has demonstrated a financially sustainable business without continual outside funding.
entries.note: The surrounding paragraph gives 'worked out' a plain financial-sustainability reading.

entries.test: Public financial results would establish whether either lab was profitable at publication, and compute commitments would establish the growth needed to fund them.
entries.note: The profitability assertion is independently checkable; 'impossible rate' is an additional evaluative exaggeration.

entries.test: If OpenAI incurs its projected $750 billion compute spending over the stated period, public revenue and financing records would show whether either asserted funding threshold was necessary and reached.
entries.note: The spending projection supplies a roughly early-2030 horizon for the funding requirement.

entries.test: Published consensus estimates and division of $186 billion by $18.7 billion would establish the stated approximately ten-year payback at zero costs.
entries.note: This is arithmetic using current estimates, not a prediction that annual revenue will remain constant for a decade.

entries.test: Financial statements and revenue expectation revisions after the AI investment cycle unwinds would show whether the named companies' financial condition materially worsened because of exposure to the two labs.
entries.note: The surrounding discussion supplies a financial reading of 'worse condition'; Meta's inclusion is tentative.
The claim judges whether the business justifies its investment and balance-sheet costs.
The metaphor supplies no distinct measurable commitment.

entries.test: Public AI data-center loan balances, repayment and default records, and lender loss disclosures would show whether the vast majority went unpaid and impaired banks and private credit funds.
entries.note: 'I believe' introduces a firm prediction here, rather than a stated chance or possibility.

entries.test: Public semiconductor sales, customer investment and utilization records, and subsequent growth disclosures would show whether speculative AI purchases inflated earnings and their unwinding reduced growth.
entries.note: The central assertion is a causal chain with a firm growth consequence. Impairments and restatements are presented only as possibilities.

entries.test: Comparable GPU operating costs, unfinished data-center completion costs, and electricity prices in August 2031 versus August 2026 would test the five-year cost prediction.
entries.note: The normalization omits his additional commitment that these conditions will occur after easy venture-capital fundraising has ended.
The time-bomb metaphor and universal prediction of retrospective surprise provide no distinct testable threshold.
The joke and punchline language expresses contempt and anticipated harm without a specific testable outcome.
